calibration_match: next cyclic canonical IDSSE match; excluded from base and finetuning
validation_match: original own-inner-validation match; excluded from base, finetuning and calibrator fitting
training: remaining four IDSSE matches; no SkillCorner; fixed common 12-epoch base checkpoint, then exactly eight epochs for every arm
expansion_gate: no automatic seven-fold search; stop after pilots unless directional improvement over binary exceeds 0.01 robust spellF1 and 0.01 short-spell recall on BOTH own validations
independent_transfer: twenty SkillCorner matches, conditional team only on valid partial labels; no H/A/D or spellF1 inferred; frozen pilot models never trained or calibrated on SkillCorner
test_policy: all pilot selections frozen before either pilot outer-test evaluation; no decisions transferred between folds; previously studied IDSSE remains exploratory
